content: Every thought which genius thinketh, he might think; had other men but thought it before, he would have thought it also.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Great insights do not belong exclusively to famous historical geniuses; they are universal truths residing in the common mind of humanity, accessible to anyone who listens deeply.
practicalInsight: Do not intimidate yourself by placing geniuses on distant pedestals; universal wisdom is accessible to your mind as well.
reflectionPrompt: What deep universal truth is knocking at the door of your mind right now?
